mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, while tolterodine has anticholinergic properties; combined use increases risk of anticholinergic toxicity and potential hypertensive crisis if sympathomimetic effects are potentiated.
action: Avoid this combination if possible; if use is necessary, monitor closely for anticholinergic effects (urinary retention, severe constipation, tachycardia, hyperthermia) and blood pressure changes.
